night-toadstool: !Make the first photograph into the same place at night. Keep the exact same composition, camera position, buildings, trees, water and land. The sky becomes a dark night sky glowing with aurora, colored like the second photograph: magenta and pink with a soft green band, a few stars. The land is dark and lit faintly pink and green by the aurora; no lamps or lit windows. Large-format long-exposure photograph, fine grain, muted. No text.
sky-toadstool: !Make a black-and-white mask of this photograph at the same size and composition: pure white (#FFFFFF) everywhere that is open sky, pure black (#000000) everywhere else (land, trees, buildings, water, structures, people). Hard clean edges. Nothing else, no gray, no text.

drawn2-cal: !Redraw the person in the first image the way the second and third drawings are made: a fast, crude, naive contour drawing with an uneven wobbly pen line, like a quick stylus sketch on a tablet. Very few lines: outline of the head, eyes, nose, mouth, a hint of hair and collar. No hatching, no realistic shading, just two or three flat gray marker smudges. Proportions a little off, the way a quick sketch is. Same framing and pose as the photo. Plain white background only.
